detail.title: Auxiliary device for wall brick pasting
detail.abstract: The invention discloses an auxiliary device for wall brick pasting, a sleeve is arranged at the bottom of a shell, the central axis of the sleeve and the central axis of the shell are on the same vertical straight line, the number of the fixing pieces is four, and the four fixing pieces are fixed on the side surface of the shell in an equal angle, the whole structure of the device is compact, the connection among all parts is tight, the division of labor of all parts is clear, the operation process can be finished by one hand through the lifting handle, the use method is simple, the folding is convenient, the portability is improved, the pushing device is matched with the leather cup to apply certain pressure to the ceramic tile, simultaneously, the vibration motors are started, the four vibration motors drive the support rod and the rubber hammer to vibrate at high frequency, the ceramic tile is vibrated and knocked to a small extent, so that all parts of the ceramic tile are uniformly stressed, and the adhesive can be uniformly filled between the ceramic tile and the wall.
assignees: 济南林海装饰工程有限公司
